BiblicalUsage: Lotan was one of the sons of Seir the Horite, who lived in the land of Edom before any king reigned in Israel. His children were Hori and Hemam, and his sister was Timna. The genealogies list him twice, in Genesis and again in Chronicles, as part of the Horite line.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even a bare name in a genealogy matters, because God keeps the record of peoples the world forgets.
